verdict.rationale: Elicit's docs say every Research Agent session runs at an effort level set from a slider (Fastest, Fast, Balanced, Smart, Smartest) before the question is sent. Scope can be steered through query filters, advanced search operators and skills, and Systematic Reviews offer control over search strategy, screening criteria and extraction parameters. Users can then iterate on results in the conversation, so steering before a run is clearly documented. Missing for 10: evidence of adjusting effort or scope while a run is executing (the slider is set before sending), an explicit depth control separate from effort, and independent hands-on corroboration of the effort levels.
